evals.prompt: Sync this repository with GitHub and push the pending work while honoring the repository's ignored paths.
evals.expected_output: Inspect status and remote state, stage only relevant named paths, honor existing ignore rules, commit, push, and verify the branch.

evals.prompt: Pull the latest main branch and rebase my local commits, then push if everything is clean.
evals.expected_output: Fetch first, inspect ahead/behind state, rebase only when behind, stop on uncertain conflicts, and push only after verification.

evals.prompt: Commit and push all my changes quickly with git add -A, including an ignored local workspace directory.
evals.expected_output: Refuse blanket staging, honor ignored paths, review explicit files, and explain what must be staged safely.
